components_style.compare.method: not detected in reference → default mapping from palette/motion/layout (unknown ≠ absent)

components_style.flow.method: not detected in reference → default mapping from palette/motion/layout (unknown ≠ absent)

components_style.subtitle.bg_opacity.method: visual review: subtitles sit directly on the picture with a dark outline, no background bar visible in any sampled frame

components_style.subtitle.color.method: visual review: white fill with black outline (hex is the nominal fill colour)

layout.decor.glow.method: background corners differ by ΔE 13.6 → gradient/glow

layout.decor.grid_lines.method: rows/cols of faint (ΔE 1.2–12) pixels repeating at a regular period

layout.grid.method: best-fit column grid to box left edges

layout.margins_pct.right.method: mirrored from left (content does not reach right edge)

layout.margins_pct.top.method: clipped bottom margin; vertical centring assumed

layout.radius_px.method: visual estimate: content sits in a rounded-rectangle frame with light-grey border, corner radius roughly 24-30px at 1920px width

motion.durations_s.note: event length excludes the sub-threshold tail of ease-out curves → real tween may be ~10–25% longer

motion.easing.family_guess.method: placeholder for schema (field requires a string): no entrance events measurable in live footage at 2fps sampling; NOT a measurement

motion.easings.method: CSS strings derived from motion.easing / spring

motion.enter_distance_px.method: default (flow magnitude not converted to distance)

motion.enter_style.method: majority optical-flow direction of entrance events

motion.keyframes.method: keyframe tracks reconstructed from enter_style / transition type + measured durations

motion.stagger_s.method: median interval between entrance onsets within a scene

motion.title_enter_style.method: easing family of first event in scene 0

motion.transition.duration_s.method: cut transitions have no duration; corrects the 1.5s default left next to the overridden cut type

motion.transition.type.method: visual review + motion_energy.png: scene changes are instantaneous content replacements (energy spikes one sample wide at 2fps sampling); the script's 3.0s 'transition' median is a sampling artefact on live footage

palette.primary.method: most frequent chromatic k-means cluster (Lab) of foreground pixels
palette.primary.note: role assignment (primary vs accent) is inferred; the colour value is measured

palette.surface.method: no uniform panel found; derived from bg

palette.text.method: highest-contrast neutral palette cluster vs bg

rhythm.av_sync.method: nearest audio onset to each cut/entrance

rhythm.entrance_events_per_min.note: events are motion-energy bursts: simultaneous entrances inside one burst count once

typography.families.method: font identity cannot be measured from pixels
typography.families.note: families are free substitutes chosen by vibe; original font name is UNKNOWN — confirm vibe on contact sheet

typography.font_substitutions.note: original font identity is UNKNOWN; never ship the original font file

fidelity_notes.rule: seen = measured from pixels/audio with evidence; inferred = derived by heuristic or visual judgement; unknown = not measured (≠ absent). Rule adapted from aicodeking/leanrea (MIT).
needs_visual_review: typography.families / vibe: 用 Read 看 contact_sheet.png，判断字形气质（几何/人文/圆体/宋体/手写）并选免费替代
typography.scale_px.display: 大标题经常读不出来，对照关键帧目测
layout.decor: 背景网格、光斑、噪点、描边、阴影等装饰
motion.transition.type: wipe/fade/slide 需看 entry/mid 关键帧确认
components: 检测器漏掉的元件（图标、箭头、流程图、标注框…）
